Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 17

“But the person who delights in the self alone, who is satisfied with the self and content within the self — for that one there is nothing to be done.”

A genuine exemption, and Krishna states it plainly. Someone whose fulfilment has no external source has no work left that is driven by need. Arjuna is not that person yet.
